articles.titleCn: SimpCue：基于提示的多语言文本简化
articles.abstractCn: 文本简化旨在使复杂文本更易于理解，同时保留其原始含义。近期的大型语言模型可以通过提示进行简化，但尚不清楚向提示中添加关于句子复杂性的显式语言信息是否能改善其输出效果。我们针对加泰罗尼亚语、西班牙语和意大利语的多语言句子级易读性简化问题进行了研究。使用Qwen3-8B模型，我们比较了基础提示、富含黄金语言线索的黄金线索提示，以及富含自动预测线索的预测线索提示。我们使用SARI、BLEU、chrF和BERTScore评估了输出结果，并辅以人工定性分析。预测线索提示在所有四个指标上获得了最佳综合得分，尽管其相较于基线的提升微乎其微。黄金线索提示并未始终优于基线，且结果在不同语言间存在差异。这些发现表明，基于线索的提示可以影响多语言易读性简化，但其优势有限、指标相关且语言相关。

articles.title: A Shaky Voice Is Not Always a Dodge: Benchmarking Textual and Vocal Evasion Detection in Earnings Calls
articles.abstract: Existing approaches to evasion detection in earnings calls focus on textual transcripts, treating evasion as a single-dimensional phenomenon. We argue that evasion in spoken communication is inherently multidimensional: beyond what executives say, how they say it carries independent and complementary information. To study these dimensions jointly, we introduce DualEvasion, a benchmark for evasion detection across text and audio in earnings call Q&A. The benchmark contains 505 annotated question-answer pairs from 60 earnings calls, each with two independent labels: textual evasion (direct vs. evasive) and vocal cues operationalized as speaker confidence (confident vs. unconfident). Our experiments show that state-of-the-art multimodal models struggle to detect vocal confidence, particularly on unconfident responses. Our analysis suggests these models interpret acoustic cues in isolation rather than relative to each speaker's baseline. Providing speaker-level references yields modest improvements, but a substantial gap with human performance remains.
articles.titleCn: 颤抖的声音并不总是回避：在财报电话会议中基准测试文本和语音回避检测
articles.abstractCn: 现有的收益电话中的规避检测方法主要关注文本记录，将规避视为单一维度的现象。我们认为，口语交流中的规避本质上具有多维性：除了高管所说的内容，他们说话的方式也包含独立且互补的信息。为了共同研究这些维度，我们引入了DualEvasion，这是一个用于收益电话问答中跨文本和音频的规避检测基准。该基准包含来自60场收益电话的505个标注问答对，每个问答对有两个独立的标签：文本规避（直接与规避）和声音线索，后者以说话者信心（自信与不自信）的形式进行操作化。我们的实验表明，最先进的多模态模型在检测声音信心方面存在困难，尤其是在不自信的回应上。我们的分析表明，这些模型孤立地解释声学线索，而不是相对于每个说话者的基线。提供说话者级别的参考确实带来了适度的改进，但与人类表现相比仍存在巨大差距。

articles.title: Twin Worlds: Equivariance-Based Abstention for Evidence-Grounded Reasoning
articles.abstract: Knowledge-intensive reasoning requires Large Language Models (LLMs) to ground answers in provided evidence. When evidence is insufficient, it is desirable that models abstain rather than confidently generating unsupported answers. Existing abstention methods rely on uncertainty estimation or evidence sufficiency checks, but neither tests whether the reasoning process for generation, driven by the interaction of provided evidence and the model's internal memory parameters, is actually grounded in the evidence. A key contributing factor is that entity mentions in context activate memorised associations, causing models to generate plausible responses ungrounded in evidence. We propose Twin Worlds (TW), a framework for improving reliability in knowledge-intensive reasoning through equivariance-based abstention: unlike invariance, which requires outputs to remain unchanged, equivariance requires outputs to transform correspondingly under entity substitutions. A model grounded in the evidence should produce answers that shift consistently when entities are substituted while their relations are preserved. TW constructs multiple worlds via typed substitutions of the original input that preserve relational structure while reducing parametric priors, and uses equivariance violations as an abstention signal. Across four benchmarks and three model backbones, TW identifies when answers are not reliably grounded in the provided evidence and outperforms uncertainty- and sufficiency-based baselines.
articles.titleCn: 双世界：基于等变性的证据推理中的弃权
articles.abstractCn: 知识密集型推理要求大型语言模型（LLM）将答案与提供的证据相结合。当证据不足时，模型最好选择放弃，而不是自信地生成未经支持答案。现有的放弃方法依赖于不确定性估计或证据充分性检查，但它们都没有测试生成推理过程是否真正基于证据。一个关键因素是上下文中的实体提及会激活记忆中的关联，导致模型生成与证据无关的合理响应。我们提出了双世界（TW）框架，通过基于等变性的放弃机制来提高知识密集型推理的可靠性：与不变性要求输出保持不变不同，等变性要求在实体替换时输出相应地变换。基于证据的模型在实体替换时应始终如一地改变答案，同时保持其关系。TW通过原始输入的带类型替换构建多个世界，在保持关系结构的同时减少参数先验，并利用等变性违反作为放弃信号。在四个基准测试和三种模型主干上，TW能够识别答案是否可靠地基于提供的证据，并优于基于不确定性和充分性的基线模型。

articles.title: Beyond Global Scalars: Synergizing Token-Level Statistics and Deep Semantics for Adversarial AIGC Text Detection
articles.abstract: The rapid evolution of large language models necessitates robust machine-generated text detection. Existing paradigms typically follow two isolated tracks. Training-free methods rely on global statistical scalars such as perplexity, while training-based methods utilize semantic hidden states. Both approaches exhibit fundamental vulnerabilities in adversarial scenarios. Global scalars act as lossy compressions that obscure local probabilistic burstiness in interleaved texts, whereas pure semantic models overfit to specific fingerprints and remain susceptible to spoofing. To expose these flaws, we introduce MOSAIC, a comprehensive adversarial benchmark comprising 16000 samples across a full-granularity attack spectrum. To address these challenges, we propose NeuroStat, an end-to-end framework bridging the statistical and semantic gap. NeuroStat captures uncompressed token-level probabilistic logits alongside deep semantic hidden states from a single causal language model backbone. We fuse these heterogeneous signals through Macro-State Residual Modulation, which adaptively calibrates local convolutional features using global uncertainty indicators. Orthogonal and contrastive losses further ensure the learning of complementary representations. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NeuroStat maintains exceptional robustness on MOSAIC compared to the severe degradation of state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new standard for adversarial text detection. Code and the MOSAIC benchmark are available at https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat.
articles.titleCn: 超越全局标量：整合符号级统计与深度语义以进行对抗性AIGC文本检测
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型的快速演进迫切需要强大的机器生成文本检测技术。现有范式通常遵循两条孤立的技术路线。无训练方法依赖于诸如困惑度等全局统计量，而基于训练的方法则利用语义隐藏状态。这两种方法在对抗场景中都存在根本性的缺陷。全局统计量充当有损压缩，掩盖了交织文本中的局部概率突发性，而纯语义模型会过拟合特定的指纹并容易受到欺骗。为了揭示这些缺陷，我们引入了MOSAIC，这是一个包含16000个样本、覆盖全粒度攻击谱的综合对抗基准。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了NeuroStat，这是一个端到端的框架，弥合了统计和语义之间的差距。NeuroStat从单个因果语言模型主干中捕获未压缩的token级概率logits以及深层语义隐藏状态。我们通过宏观状态残差调制融合这些异构信号，该技术利用全局不确定性指标自适应地校准局部卷积特征。正交和对比损失进一步确保互补表示的学习。大量实验表明，与最先进方法的严重退化相比，NeuroStat在MOSAIC上保持了卓越的鲁棒性，为对抗文本检测确立了新的标准。代码和MOSAIC基准可在https://github.com/TencentBAC/NeuroStat获取。

articles.title: Predicting Turn-Taking Outcomes in Multi-Party Conversation: Interpretable Modelling of Speech and Gaze Dynamics with Interpersonal Closeness
articles.abstract: Smooth speaker transitions are fundamental to effective conversation and rely on an interlocutor's ability to predict when to enter the conversation. This ability depends on accurately interpreting and expressing the verbal and non-verbal cues that signal when a speaker wishes to take or relinquish the floor. The process becomes even more complex in noisy, natural, multi-party settings, with multiple interlocutors available. This study models how gaze and speech, together with perceived interpersonal closeness, signal conversational floor changes in free four-person dialogue. Using the GaMMA corpus, we trained logistic regression models using interpretable, behaviourally motivated features extracted before each turn-taking event to classify floor-transfer outcomes as gaps or overlaps. Predictors included gaze features such as transition motifs and behavioural contrasts, entropy, gaze-based addressee identity, and mutual gaze, alongside speech features derived from speaker loudness, as well as perceived interpersonal closeness (IOS) between speakers. Results show that gaze features capture predictive structure, and that combining them with loudness improves performance (ROC AUC = 0.76 +- 0.04). Loudness reflected speaker control, while gaze dispersion and addressing indexed listener readiness and competitive entry. Performance remained robust across noise conditions, indicating that gaze provides a complementary, noise-resilient cue to turn-taking dynamics.

articles.titleCn: 预测多方对话中的轮流发言结果：基于人际亲密度的语音与注视动态的可解释建模
articles.abstractCn: 流畅的说话者转换是有效对话的基础，这依赖于对话者预测何时进入对话的能力。这种能力取决于准确解读和表达信号说话者希望发言或让出话轮的言语和非言语线索。在嘈杂、自然、多方的对话环境中，这个过程变得更加复杂，因为有多个对话者可供选择。本研究模拟了在自由四人对话中，视线和言语如何与感知的人际亲密感共同信号对话话轮的变化。使用GaMMA语料库，我们通过在每次发言前提取可解释的、基于行为动机的特征来训练逻辑回归模型，将话轮转移结果分类为间隔或重叠。预测因素包括视线特征，如转换模式和行为对比、熵、基于视线的受话人身份和互视，以及从说话者音量推导出的言语特征，以及说话者之间感知的人际亲密感（IOS）。结果表明，视线特征捕捉了预测结构，并将它们与音量结合可以提高性能（ROC AUC = 0.76 +- 0.04）。音量反映了说话者的控制力，而视线分散和受话人索引则显示了听众的准备状态和竞争性进入。在不同噪音条件下，性能保持稳健，表明视线为话轮动态提供了互补的、抗噪音的线索。

articles.title: QUORUM: QUality-Optimized Routing Using Multiple annotators
articles.abstract: Data annotation remains a central bottleneck in natural language processing, requiring human effort to obtain high-quality labels at scale. While Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a fast and cost-effective alternative, their reliability is highly instance-dependent: they perform well on simple inputs but often fail on examples requiring nuanced reasoning or contextual understanding. In this work, we address this challenge with QUORUM (QUality-Optimized Routing Using Multiple annotators), a budget-aware routing framework that dynamically assigns each instance to human or LLM annotators under a fixed annotation budget. Unlike prior approaches relying on model confidence or uncertainty estimates, QUORUM leverages feature-based signals to estimate instance difficulty and supports multiple annotations per instance, combining them through agreement-based rewards to improve reliability. We evaluate QUORUM across diverse closed- and open-ended annotation tasks in English and multilingual settings, and QUORUM improves annotation quality by up to 34.4% while reducing costs by 8.8% over competing methods. Code can be found at https://github.com/amazon-science/QUORUM.
articles.titleCn: 群体：使用多个标注者的质量优化路由
articles.abstractCn: 数据标注仍然是自然语言处理中的核心瓶颈，需要大量人力来获取高质量的标注。尽管大型语言模型（LLM）提供了一种快速且经济的替代方案，但它们的可靠性高度依赖于具体实例：它们在简单输入上表现良好，但在需要细致推理或上下文理解的示例上往往失败。在这项工作中，我们通过QUORUM（QUality-Optimized Routing Using Multiple annotators，基于质量优化的多标注者路由框架）来解决这一挑战，该框架在固定的标注预算下动态地将每个实例分配给人类标注者或LLM标注者。与依赖模型置信度或不确定性估计的先前方法不同，QUORUM利用基于特征的信号来估计实例难度，并支持每个实例的多重标注，通过基于共识的奖励将它们结合起来以提高可靠性。我们在英语和多语言环境下的多种封闭式和开放式标注任务中评估了QUORUM，结果显示QUORUM在提高标注质量方面比竞争方法提高了高达34.4%，同时降低了8.8%的成本。代码可在https://github.com/amazon-science/QUORUM找到。

articles.title: DisCTI: Who Needs to Know Timely? Automated Sector-Aware Cyber Threat Intelligence Dissemination
articles.abstract: The timely dissemination of cyber threat intelligence (CTI) is critical for organizations to mount swift and effective incident response. When valid CTI is delivered to the right sector at the right time, identical attacks can often be contained or mitigated. However, today's rapidly expanding CTI landscape overwhelms analysts, who must sift through massive and heterogeneous feeds. Existing platforms such as the Malware Information Sharing Platform (MISP) provide sector tagging features (e.g., energy, finance, government), but in practice, these remain largely unmapped (98% of events are left uncategorized). This lack of automated and timely sector mapping severely limits the operational value of shared intelligence, leaving organizations that belong especially to the critical information infrastructure sector exposed. To address this gap, we formulate sector-targeted CTI dissemination as a multilabel classification problem. Leveraging deep field knowledge of CTI structures and sector-specific threat patterns, we construct a novel data set of 872 sector-labelled CTI events from a threat intelligence platform (TIP). We then apply BERT, a transformer-based model, to automate the mapping of CTI events to sectors. Using the structured threat information expression (STIX) format for cross-platform interoperability, our approach achieves a macro-averaged F1-score of 0.89 at a Hamming loss of 0.055 on the custom dataset, i.e. 94.5% of individual sector-label assignments are correct. These results not only demonstrate the feasibility of sector-aware, automated CTI dissemination but also highlight how embedding expert field knowledge into machine learning design fills a crucial gap in the threat intelligence pipeline, enabling faster and context-relevant defensive action.
articles.titleCn: DisCTI：谁需要及时了解？自动化领域感知网络威胁情报传播
articles.abstractCn: 及时传播网络威胁情报（CTI）对于组织迅速有效地进行事件响应至关重要。当有效的CTI在恰当的时间送达恰当的领域时，往往能够阻止或减轻同类攻击。然而，如今快速扩展的CTI领域让分析师们应接不暇，他们必须从大量异构的数据流中筛选信息。现有的平台如恶意软件信息共享平台（MISP）提供了领域标签功能（例如能源、金融、政府），但在实践中，这些功能基本未被使用（98%的事件未分类）。这种缺乏自动化和及时的领域映射严重限制了共享情报的操作价值，特别是使属于关键信息基础设施领域的组织面临风险。为解决这一差距，我们将面向领域的CTI传播视为一个多标签分类问题。利用CTI结构和领域特定威胁模式的深度领域知识，我们从威胁情报平台（TIP）构建了一个包含872个领域标签CTI事件的新型数据集。然后，我们应用基于Transformer的模型BERT，自动将CTI事件映射到领域。使用结构化威胁信息表达（STIX）格式实现跨平台互操作性，我们的方法在自定义数据集上实现了0.055的汉明损失和0.89的宏平均F1分数，即94.5%的个体领域标签分配是正确的。这些结果不仅证明了领域感知自动化CTI传播的可行性，还突出了如何将专家领域知识嵌入机器学习设计中，填补了威胁情报流程中的关键空白，从而实现更快、更相关的防御行动。

articles.title: Lexically conditioned realization ambiguity in Korean predicate morphology
articles.abstract: This paper examines Korean surface realization as distinct from morphological analysis. It asks whether a sequence of canonical morphemes and grammatical category labels uniquely determines the corresponding surface form. The answer is negative for a restricted but theoretically revealing class of Korean predicates. In these cases, formally identical or near-identical stem-ending configurations yield different outputs depending on lexical identity and realization class membership. We analyze this phenomenon as homonymy with inflectional divergence, focusing on regular versus digeut irregular pairs, regular versus bieup irregular pairs, and reu irregular versus reo irregular pairs. These cases show that stem shape and ending alone do not always determine surface realization. Instead, lexical meaning, subcategorization, and semantic role structure help identify the intended predicate; the predicate determines the realization class; and the realization class determines the surface form. Korean realization thus reveals a limit of bare morphological representation.
articles.titleCn: 朝鲜语谓词形态中的词汇条件实现歧义
articles.abstractCn: 本文探讨了不同于形态分析的韩国表层实现。它询问一系列规范词素和语法类别标签是否唯一地决定了相应的表层形式。对于一类受限但理论上具有启发性的韩国谓词，答案是负面的。在这些情况下，形式上相同或几乎相同的词干结尾配置会根据词汇身份和实现类别成员资格产生不同的输出。我们将这种现象分析为具有屈折分歧的同音异义现象，重点关注规则与不规则（digeut）对、规则与不规则（bieup）对，以及不规则（reu）与不规则（reo）对。这些案例表明，仅凭词干形状和词尾并不总是决定表层实现。相反，词汇意义、次范畴化和语义角色结构有助于识别预期的谓词；谓词决定了实现类别；实现类别决定了表层形式。韩国实现揭示了裸形态表示的一个局限性。

articles.title: Entity-Memory Graph Retrieval Improves Evidence Coverage in Long-Conversation Question Answering
articles.abstract: Entity-Memory graph retrieval keeps dialogue turns as verbatim Memory nodes, links repeated mentions through shared Entities, and connects adjacent Memories with directed chronological edges. At query time the retriever moves from Entity gating through semantic fusion and one-hop chronological recovery to dense backfill. The path can keep a neighboring Memory that dense cosine ranking would otherwise omit. A matched dense control shares the Memory and query vectors, context budget, requested answer protocol, and evaluator, isolating graph structure from changes to the reader. On 1,986 questions from ten LoCoMo conversations, graph retrieval raises official evidence recall at top-k 25 from 79.7468% to 84.4842%. The recall advantage is supported from top-k 5 to 50, while no matched cutoff supports an overall final-answer F1 difference. Four paper-eligible requested configurations support empirical robustness across the tested GPT-3.5 and DeepSeek extractors on both outcomes. Embedding robustness is mixed: F1 has no supported contrast, but recall is sensitive to the embedding artifact. The comparison isolates a retrieval-coverage gain from graph structure. It does not establish a final-answer F1 gain, model or embedding equivalence, or cross-dataset generalization.
articles.titleCn: 实体-记忆图检索提升了长对话问答中的证据覆盖率
articles.abstractCn: 实体-记忆图检索将对话轮次作为逐字记忆节点，通过共享实体链接重复提及，并使用有向时间边连接相邻记忆。在查询时，检索器从实体门控通过语义融合和单跳时间恢复到密集回填。该路径可以保留密集余弦排序可能遗漏的邻近记忆。匹配的密集控制共享记忆和查询向量、上下文预算、请求的答案协议和评估器，使图结构不受读者变化的干扰。在来自十个LoCoMo对话的1986个问题中，图检索将官方证据召回率在top-k 25中从79.7468%提高到84.4842%。召回率优势从top-k 5到50都得到支持，但没有任何匹配截止支持整体最终答案F1的差异。四种符合论文发表标准的请求配置在测试的GPT-3.5和DeepSeek提取器上对两种结果都表现出实证鲁棒性。嵌入鲁棒性表现不一：F1没有支持对比，但召回率对嵌入伪影敏感。比较从图结构中分离出检索覆盖率的提升。它没有建立最终答案F1的提升、模型或嵌入等价性，或跨数据集泛化。

articles.title: What Makes Agent Memory Useful for Reliable Unanswerable Question Handling?
articles.abstract: Reliable handling of unanswerable questions (UAQs) is critical for trustworthy LLM-based agents. Although memory is widely used in agent systems, its role in reliable UAQ handling remains unclear. We present a systematic study of agent memory for UAQ handling under a unified agentic RAG framework, evaluating four representative memory methods across three UAQ-related datasets and two base models. We find that memory can improve UAQ performance in some settings, but such gains are selective rather than universal and remain fragile under dataset shift. Interestingly, cross-model memory reuse is often more feasible than cross-dataset transfer, suggesting that shifts in answerability patterns pose a greater challenge to memory reuse than changes in the base model itself. We further find that UAQ gains are more strongly preserved through decision guidance than through trajectory shaping, and that memory effectiveness depends strongly on representation. In particular, procedural and rule-based memories often provide the most reliable support for UAQ handling, while memory composition is most effective when procedural guidance is combined with complementary behavioral signals. Overall, our findings suggest that reliable UAQ memory depends less on storing larger amounts of experience and more on preserving transferable behavioral guidance.
articles.titleCn: 是什么让智能体记忆在可靠地处理无法回答的问题时变得有用？
articles.abstractCn: 对无法回答的问题（UAQs）的可靠处理对于值得信赖的大型语言模型（LLM）代理至关重要。尽管记忆在代理系统中被广泛使用，但其在对UAQ进行可靠处理中的作用尚不明确。我们在统一的代理式检索增强生成（RAG）框架下，对代理记忆在处理UAQ方面的作用进行了系统研究，并在三个与UAQ相关的数据集和两个基础模型上评估了四种具有代表性的记忆方法。我们发现，在特定情况下，记忆可以提高UAQ的性能，但这种提升具有选择性而非普适性，并且在数据集迁移时仍然不稳定。有趣的是，跨模型的记忆重用通常比跨数据集迁移更可行，这表明答案能力模式的迁移比基础模型本身的改变对记忆重用提出了更大的挑战。我们进一步发现，通过决策指导比通过轨迹塑造更能有效保留UAQ的收益，并且记忆的有效性高度依赖于表示方式。特别是，程序性和基于规则的记忆通常为UAQ处理提供了最可靠的支持，而记忆组合在程序性指导与互补行为信号相结合时最为有效。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，可靠的UAQ记忆更多地依赖于保留可迁移的行为指导，而非存储更多的经验。

articles.title: AI Alignment through a Game-theoretic Lens: A Survey
articles.abstract: As large language models and increasingly capable AI agents are deployed in high-risk settings, aligning them with complex human values has become a central challenge. Existing alignment methods, while effective in improving helpfulness, harmlessness, and controllability, often struggle to capture real-world preferences that are context-dependent, non-transitive, and shaped by dynamic multi-party interactions. This survey reviews AI alignment through a game-theoretic lens. Specifically, it organizes recent progress around key game-theoretic elements and synthesizes the literature along three challenges: preference diversity, alignment priority, and temporal dynamics. This perspective clarifies where current alignment methods genuinely benefit from game-theoretic analysis, where the framework is looser, and what challenges remain in building robust, adaptive, and verifiable AI systems.

articles.titleCn: 从博弈论视角看人工智能对齐：一项调查
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型和日益强大的AI代理越来越多地部署在高风险环境中，将它们与复杂的人类价值观相协调已成为一个核心挑战。现有的协调方法虽然有效提高了有用性、无害性和可控性，但往往难以捕捉依赖于上下文、非传递性且受动态多方交互影响的真实世界偏好。本综述从博弈论视角审视AI协调。具体而言，它围绕关键博弈论要素组织了近期进展，并沿着三个挑战——偏好多样性、协调优先级和时序动态——整合了文献。这一视角阐明了当前协调方法在哪些方面确实受益于博弈论分析，博弈论框架在哪些方面较为松散，以及构建稳健、自适应和可验证的AI系统时仍面临哪些挑战。

articles.title: LandingAgent: A Reference-Annotated Dataset and Agentic Generation Framework for Landing Pages
articles.abstract: Landing pages are goal-oriented web interfaces that must communicate a target-specific value proposition while organizing information flow, visual hierarchy, and calls to action (CTA). Although large language models can generate plausible webpage code from natural-language prompts, direct generation often yields generic templates and unsupported persuasive claims. We study target-grounded, reference-guided landing-page generation, where a system must create an executable page for a new target by adapting reusable patterns from real pages without copying them. We introduce LandingBench, a reference-profile dataset that abstracts real landing pages into section sequences, layout patterns, tone descriptors, visual emphasis, and CTA structure. Building on LandingBench, we propose LandingAgent, a three-phase agentic framework that profiles the target, constructs a reference-guided wireframe, and refines the page through critique-guided polishing. We evaluate LandingAgent against direct prompting on faithfulness, conciseness, readability, aesthetics, and structural diversity. Experiments show improved target grounding, presentation quality, and layout diversity. Code is available at https://github.com/IAURAI/LandingAgent.
articles.titleCn: LandingAgent：一个用于着陆页的参考注释数据集和代理生成框架
articles.abstractCn: 落地页是目标导向的网页界面，必须传达针对特定目标的价值主张，同时组织信息流、视觉层级和行动号召（CTA）。尽管大型语言模型可以根据自然语言提示生成看似合理的网页代码，但直接生成往往会产生通用的模板和不支持的劝导性声明。我们研究了以目标为基础、参考引导的落地页生成，其中系统必须通过改编真实页面中的可重用模式（而不复制它们）来为新的目标创建可执行的页面。我们介绍了LandingBench，这是一个参考特征数据集，将真实落地页抽象为部分序列、布局模式、语气描述、视觉强调和CTA结构。基于LandingBench，我们提出了LandingAgent，这是一个三阶段智能体框架，用于分析目标、构建参考引导的线框图，并通过评论引导的优化来完善页面。我们通过忠实度、简洁性、可读性、美观性和结构多样性五个方面，评估了LandingAgent与直接提示的效果。实验表明，LandingAgent在目标基础性、呈现质量和布局多样性方面有所改进。代码可在https://github.com/IAURAI/LandingAgent获取。

articles.title: OpenStamp: A Watermark for Open-Source Language Models
articles.abstract: With the growing prevalence of large language model (LLM) generated content, watermarking is considered a promising approach for attributing text to LLMs and distinguishing it from human-written content. A prominent class of techniques embeds subtle but detectable signals in generated text by modifying token sampling probabilities. However, such methods are unsuitable for open-source models, where users have white-box access and can easily disable watermarking during inference. In this work, we introduce OpenStamp, a watermarking technique that encodes the watermarking logic directly into the model weights by modifying only the final projection, or unembedding, layer. Through experiments across two models, we show that OpenStamp achieves superior detection performance, with minimal degradation in model capabilities compared to prior methods. The implanted watermark is explicitly designed, and empirically confirmed, to be more robust to paraphrasing attacks and harder to scrub off through post-hoc fine-tuning than prior open-source watermarks. To enable developers to watermark their models, we release our code alongside watermarked versions of 4 popular open-source models.
articles.titleCn: OpenStamp：开源语言模型的数字水印
articles.abstractCn: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）生成内容日益普遍，水印技术被视为一种将文本归属到LLM并区分于人类撰写内容的有效方法。一类突出技术通过修改标记采样概率，在生成文本中嵌入微妙但可检测的信号。然而，这类方法不适用于开源模型，因为用户拥有白盒访问权限，并在推理过程中可以轻易禁用水印。在本工作中，我们引入了OpenStamp，一种将水印逻辑直接编码到模型权重中的水印技术，仅修改最终的投影层或去嵌入层。通过在两个模型上的实验，我们展示了OpenStamp相较于先前方法实现了更优的检测性能，且模型能力退化最小。植入的水印经过明确设计，并通过实证验证，比先前的开源水印更能抵抗释义攻击，且更难通过事后微调去除。为使开发者能够对其模型进行水印处理，我们发布了我们的代码以及4个经过水印处理的流行开源模型版本。

articles.title: AI Writers Have a Consistent Stylometric Footprint, but AI Editors Do Not
articles.abstract: Text generated by large language models (LLMs) has been shown to be stylometrically distinct from human-written text \citep{andreDetectingAIAuthorship2023, shahDetectingUnmaskingAIGenerated2023, oparaStyloAIDistinguishingAIGenerated2024, soto2024fewshot, liLinguisticDifferencesAI2025, selviogluFeatureExtractionAnalysis2025}. But LLMs are increasingly used not only to generate text but also to edit human writing, and it is unclear whether the two leave the same trace. We show that AI generation leaves a consistent ``stylometric footprint'': a small subset of features, primarily entropy and lexical diversity, consistently separates AI-generated text from human writing across 8 LLMs and 5 domains, while the remaining features depend heavily on the domain and generator. AI editing, however, does not reproduce the same footprint. Relative to their human-written sources, AI-edited texts show only a small increase in lexical diversity and a decrease in entropy, rather than the joint increase that characterizes AI generation. Lexical density, which contributes little to generation, instead becomes the dominant editing-associated signal. Stylometric features therefore separate AI-edited text from AI-generated text but are substantially less effective at separating it from human-written text. Our results suggest that ``AI text'' is not a single phenomenon: generation and editing leave qualitatively different stylometric traces and should be studied separately.
articles.titleCn: AI写手具有一致的文体特征，但AI编辑则不然。
articles.abstractCn: 大型语言模型（LLM）生成的文本已被证明在文体学上与人类撰写的文本存在差异 \citep{andreDetectingAIAuthorship2023, shahDetectingUnmaskingAIGenerated2023, oparaStyloAIDistinguishingAIGenerated2024, soto2024fewshot, liLinguisticDifferencesAI2025, selviogluFeatureExtractionAnalysis2025}。但LLM不仅越来越多地用于生成文本，还用于编辑人类写作，而两者是否留下相同痕迹尚不明确。我们表明，人工智能生成会留下一致的“文体学足迹”：一小部分特征，主要是熵和词汇多样性，在8种LLM和5个领域内始终将人工智能生成的文本与人类写作区分开来，而其余特征则严重依赖于领域和生成器。然而，人工智能编辑不会复制相同的足迹。相对于其人类来源文本，人工智能编辑文本仅在词汇多样性上略有增加，熵则有所下降，而不是像人工智能生成那样呈现联合增长。词汇密度对生成贡献不大，反而成为编辑相关的信号。因此，文体学特征可以将人工智能编辑文本与人工智能生成文本区分开来，但在将其与人类撰写文本区分开来时则效果大打折扣。我们的结果表明，“人工智能文本”并非单一现象：生成和编辑会留下质的不同的文体学痕迹，应分别进行研究。

articles.title: Is Prosody Lost in Translation? Fine-Grained Cross-Lingual Prosody Similarity Across Languages
articles.abstract: Prosody plays an important role in speech translation, conveying information such as emphasis, emotion, and intent beyond lexical content. However, despite recent progress in expressive speech-to-speech translation (S2ST), little is known about how prosodic patterns are similar/different across languages. Understanding these cross-lingual similarities and differences is crucial for effectively incorporating prosody into expressive S2ST systems. In this work, we present the first fine-grained cross-lingual analysis of prosody using multilingual dubbing data across English-German, English-Spanish, and English-French language pairs. We analyze the similarity of pitch, energy, and temporal feature patterns between source and target speech and investigate the linguistic and alignment-related factors affecting this similarity. Our analysis reveals inherent cross-lingual correlations in prosodic structure between certain languages. The findings provide important insights into the transferability of prosody across languages and offer empirical guidance for future expressive speech-to-speech translation systems.
articles.titleCn: 韵律在翻译中会丢失吗？跨语言的细粒度韵律相似性
articles.abstractCn: 韵律在语音翻译中扮演着重要角色，它传递着词汇内容之外的强调、情感和意图等信息。然而，尽管近年来在表达性语音到语音翻译（S2ST）方面取得了进展，但人们对韵律模式在不同语言中的相似性和差异性知之甚少。理解这些跨语言的相似性和差异性对于有效地将韵律融入表达性S2ST系统至关重要。在这项工作中，我们首次利用跨语言的配音数据，对英语-德语、英语-西班牙语和英语-法语语言对进行了细粒度的韵律跨语言分析。我们分析了源语言和目标语音之间音高、能量和时序特征模式的相似性，并研究了影响这种相似性的语言和校准相关因素。我们的分析揭示了某些语言之间韵律结构中固有的跨语言相关性。这些发现为韵律在不同语言中的可迁移性提供了重要见解，并为未来表达性语音到语音翻译系统提供了实证指导。

articles.title: EvoHarmBench: Breaking Content Moderation with Iterative Human-Like Evasion
articles.abstract: Existing evaluations of harmful content detection rely predominantly on static benchmarks, which struggle to reflect the interactive adversarial ecosystem of real-world content platforms where users continuously revise their expressions in response to moderation feedback. This mismatch creates a significant performance gap between offline benchmark scores and online deployment effectiveness. To the best of our knowledge, we present EvoHarmBench, the first dynamic adversarial evaluation framework for content moderation systems. The framework employs an iterative optimization loop that evolves evasion strategies at the semantic-cluster level, while simultaneously optimizing for evasion success and human readability. We systematically evaluate LLM-based defense models which are widely used in real world moderation systems. The evaluation covers 229 semantic sub-clusters across five violation categories, derived from 5,002 real-world adversarial samples collected from content platforms. Our experiments reveal substantial vulnerabilities even in leading commercial systems: after twelve optimization iterations, the attack success rate under readability constraints reaches 80.3% within SOTA LLM moderators. We will release the full benchmark data, evaluation framework, and code to encourage a shift from static benchmarking toward dynamic adversarial evaluation in content safety research.
articles.comment: Accepted to the Findings of EMNLP 2026
articles.titleCn: EvoHarmBench：通过迭代式类人规避打破内容审核
articles.abstractCn: 现有的有害内容检测评估主要依赖静态基准，难以反映真实内容平台中用户持续根据审核反馈修改表达方式的交互对抗生态。这种不匹配导致离线基准分数与在线部署效果之间存在显著性能差距。据我们所知，我们提出了EvoHarmBench，这是首个用于内容审核系统的动态对抗评估框架。该框架采用迭代优化循环，在语义簇层面演化规避策略，同时兼顾规避成功率和人类可读性。我们系统性地评估了广泛应用于现实审核系统中的基于LLM的防御模型。评估覆盖了五大违规类别中的229个语义子簇，这些子簇源自从内容平台收集的5,002个真实对抗样本。实验揭示，即使在领先的商业系统中也存在重大漏洞：在十二次优化迭代后，在可读性约束下的攻击成功率在SOTA LLM审核器中达到80.3%。我们将发布完整的基准数据、评估框架和代码，以鼓励内容安全研究从静态基准测试转向动态对抗评估。

articles.title: Synthetic Linguistic Agency: How an Embodied Mortal Agent Learns Linguistic Affordances through Consequential Social Experience
articles.abstract: Contemporary language models can converse fluently and influence human decisions, yet their exchanges do not enter a continuing, vulnerable life of their own. Linguistic-agency theory identifies this missing connection as linguistic agency and characterizes it through embodiment, linguistic participation, and precariousness: a body that acts and bears consequences, interaction that changes both agent and partner, and a future that can be sustained or lost. Two coordinated studies examine how this organization can appear in artificial systems. First, we translate these relations into inspectable criteria for Synthetic Linguistic Agency (SLA) and identify several existing SLA systems. Second, building on Homeostatically Regulated Reinforcement Learning, we develop a mortality-grounded linguistic-reinforcement-learning model and instantiate it in an Embodied Mortal Agent (EMA). The EMA learns how ways of speaking change a partner's willingness to protect it and chooses expressions by considering what those responses mean for its remaining life. Controlled experiments show that linguistic choices depend on the EMA's body and social history, change partner behavior, and adapt through experience with particular partners. When bodily consequences persist, linguistic choices alter the future of the same life; when the body is reset, their social effects remain but no longer shape continued viability. The resulting EMA exhibits SLA under our operational definition. This work motivates further research on synthetic empathy and strategic human-AI interaction: how artificial agents with persistent bodies, histories, and futures might develop and express empathy, and how people might care for, negotiate with, or govern them.
articles.titleCn: 合成语言主体：一个具身 mortal 主体如何通过后果性社会经验学习语言可供性
articles.abstractCn: 当代语言模型能够流畅对话并影响人类决策，但它们的交流并未进入持续脆弱的生命状态。语言能动性理论将这种缺失的联系定义为语言能动性，并通过具身化、语言参与和脆弱性来刻画它：一个行动并承担后果的身体、改变行动者和伙伴的互动、以及可能持续或失去的未来。两项协同研究考察了这种组织如何在人工系统中出现。首先，我们将这些关系转化为可检验的合成语言能动性（SLA）标准，并识别出几种现有的SLA系统。其次，基于稳态调节强化学习，我们开发了一个以死亡为基础的语言强化学习模型，并将其实例化于具身死亡代理（EMA）。EMA学习说话方式如何改变伙伴的保护意愿，并通过考虑这些回应对其剩余生命的影响来选择表达。受控实验表明，语言选择依赖于EMA的身体和社会历史，改变伙伴行为，并通过与特定伙伴的经验进行适应。当身体后果持续时，语言选择改变同一生命的未来；当身体被重置时，其社会效应仍然存在，但不再塑造持续的生命力。由此产生的EMA在我们的操作定义下表现出SLA。这项工作激励了合成共情和战略人机交互的进一步研究：具有持续身体、历史和未来的人工代理如何发展和表达共情，以及人们如何照顾、协商或管理它们。

articles.title: Auditing Generative Audio Calls for Known-Task Audio-LLM Evaluation
articles.abstract: Speech and audio LLMs are often evaluated by asking whether a waveform prompt beats an automatic speech recognition (ASR) transcript. For known closed-set tasks, that comparison conflates two factors: access to acoustic evidence and the need to call a generative audio model. We evaluate this distinction as a controlled call-decision problem. For each example, a policy chooses among keeping a transcript label, using encoder evidence from Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST), or WavLM, and calling Qwen2-Audio, Qwen2.5-Omni, or MOSS-Audio; the decisive ablation removes all generative actions while keeping the selector and development protocol fixed. On VocalSound, transcripts reach 0.296 accuracy, so waveform information is needed. Yet supervised CLAP and WavLM controls reach 0.850 and 0.854 with no generative audio calls. A selector with generative actions reaches 0.925 accuracy using 12.5% calls, compared with 0.921 for the matched no-call selector (paired difference 0.004; 95% CI [-0.025,0.033]). Agreement and stacking features improve weaker selectors but do not beat the strongest no-call control. For known-task endpoint claims, the relevant quantity is the marginal value of the generative call after transcript and encoder evidence have already been used.
articles.titleCn: 针对已知任务音频-大型语言模型评估的生成式音频通话审计
articles.abstractCn: 语音和音频大型语言模型通常通过询问波形提示是否优于自动语音识别（ASR）转录本来进行评估。对于已知的封闭集任务，这种比较混淆了两个因素：获取声学证据和调用生成式音频模型的必要性。我们将这种区别评估为一个受控的调用决策问题。对于每个示例，策略在保留转录标签、使用对比语言音频预训练（CLAP）、音频频谱变换器（AST）或WavLM的编码器证据以及调用Qwen2-Audio、Qwen2.5-Omni或MOSS-Audio之间进行选择；决定性的消融移除了所有生成式操作，同时保持选择器和开发协议固定。在VocalSound上，转录本准确率达到0.296，因此需要波形信息。然而，监督CLAP和WavLM控制分别达到0.850和0.854，且无需调用生成式音频。带有生成式操作的选择器使用12.5%的调用次数达到0.925的准确率，而匹配的无调用选择器准确率为0.921（配对差异0.004；95% CI [-0.025,0.033]）。一致性和堆叠特征可以改进较弱的选择器，但无法超越最强的无调用控制。对于已知任务的端点声明，相关量度是转录本和编码器证据已使用后的生成式调用的边际价值。

articles.title: PersonaEdit: Representative Sample Selection for Personalized Model Editing
articles.abstract: Personalization has attracted growing interest in LLM applications, yet existing retrieval-based approaches depend heavily on retrieval quality and degrade in long-term interactions. Model editing, which directly modifies internal model parameters to incorporate new knowledge, has demonstrated effective knowledge modification capabilities in factual knowledge editing tasks and may provide a potential solution for personalization. However, scaling model editing to personalization is non-trivial. Editing large amounts of user data increases computational cost and causes interference among edits, motivating the need for effective sample selection. To address this issue, we propose, PersonaEdit, a hidden representation clustering strategy that selects representative editing samples through proportional stratified sampling. Experiments show that model editing is effective for personalization, and that our selection strategy preserves most of the performance while substantially reducing the number of required editing samples. Beyond standalone editing, we find that combining model editing with retrieval-based prompt augmentation further improves personalization, as edited knowledge and retrieved context provide complementary information. These results demonstrate the potential of model editing as an efficient and scalable approach for LLM personalization.
articles.titleCn: PersonaEdit：个性化模型编辑中的代表性样本选择
articles.abstractCn: 个性化在大型语言模型（LLM）应用中日益受到关注，但现有的基于检索的方法严重依赖检索质量，并在长期交互中表现下降。模型编辑通过直接修改内部模型参数来整合新知识，在事实性知识编辑任务中展现出有效的知识修改能力，并可能为个性化提供潜在的解决方案。然而，将模型编辑扩展到个性化并非易事。编辑大量用户数据会增加计算成本并导致编辑之间的相互干扰，从而引发对有效样本选择的需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了PersonaEdit，一种通过比例分层抽样选择代表性编辑样本的隐藏表示聚类策略。实验表明，模型编辑对个性化是有效的，并且我们的选择策略在大幅减少所需编辑样本数量的同时，保留了大部分性能。除了独立的编辑之外，我们发现将模型编辑与基于检索的提示增强相结合，可以进一步提高个性化效果，因为编辑后的知识和检索到的上下文提供了互补信息。这些结果表明，模型编辑作为一种高效且可扩展的方法，在LLM个性化方面具有巨大潜力。

articles.title: Representation of syntax in LLMs through the lens of linear distance and similarity-aware entropy
articles.abstract: Structural probes were introduced by Hewitt and Manning to reconstruct syntactic trees from a neural language model's latent representations. They are evaluated by calculating the proportion of syntactic tree edges correctly reconstructed over an annotated corpus (as measured by undirected unlabeled attachment score). Here, we disaggregate this measure, considering undirected attachment score by label (UASL), which assesses the reconstruction accuracy of each syntactic relation separately, establishing important differences among relations that overlap linguistic distinctions. Moreover, we identify two factors that predict most of UASL's variability across relations: (i) the mean and dispersion of the linear distance (on a log scale) between the related words, and (ii) the diversity (similarity-aware entropy) of the syntactic relation's head. These results, which hold across a range of model sizes and architectures, shed light on the degree of abstraction of the representation of syntax in language models and the dependence of such representation on geometric properties of the embedding space.

articles.titleCn: 通过线性距离和相似性感知熵的视角在大型语言模型中表示句法
articles.abstractCn: 结构探针由Hewitt和Manning引入，用于从神经语言模型的潜在表示中重建句法树。它们通过计算在标注语料库上正确重建的句法树边的比例来评估（以无向无标签附接分数衡量）。在此，我们将该度量分解，考虑按标签的无向附接分数（UASL），它单独评估每种句法关系的重建准确性，从而在重叠语言差异的关系之间建立重要区别。此外，我们识别出两个因素可以预测关系间UASL的大部分变异性：(i) 相关词语之间线性距离的平均值和离散度（在对数尺度上），以及(ii) 句法关系头的多样性（考虑相似性的熵）。这些结果在不同的模型大小和架构范围内成立，揭示了语言模型中句法表示的抽象程度，以及这种表示对嵌入空间几何性质的依赖性。

articles.title: CEDAR: Automata as Verifiable Interfaces for Language-Guided Embodied Action
articles.abstract: Natural-language tasking of embodied agents is rarely just goal specification: users also impose constraints that must persist while the world changes. Code-generating LLM agents can produce plausible behaviors for such instructions, but their free-form programs provide no stable object to verify, compose with new constraints, or repair from a failing trace. We present CEDAR, a counterexample-guided framework that grounds instructions as regular languages over environment event traces. CEDAR uses a language model for semantic judgments and execution traces for correction, then represents both skills and specifications as deterministic finite automata. This turns constraints into executable finite-state objects: a learned skill can be intersected with a learned sleep at night or stay in this biome specification, yielding a controller that enforces the learned constraint by construction rather than by repeated prompting. In Minecraft, with the same simulator/API observations available to a program-generating baseline, CEDAR maintains temporal and spatial constraints that the baseline fails to preserve and amortizes reuse of learned skills, reducing cumulative LLM queries. These results suggest that regular languages offer a practical verification layer between natural-language instructions and embodied-agent policies.
articles.titleCn: CEDAR：语言指导的具身行动的可验证接口——自动机
articles.abstractCn: 对具身智能体的自然语言任务分配很少仅仅是目标指定：用户还会施加必须持续存在的约束，而世界会不断变化。代码生成型大型语言模型智能体可以针对此类指令生成合理的行动，但它们的自由形式程序无法提供稳定的对象以供验证、组合新约束或从失败的执行轨迹中修复。我们提出了CEDAR，一个基于反例引导的框架，将指令作为环境事件轨迹上的正则语言进行锚定。CEDAR使用语言模型进行语义判断，使用执行轨迹进行修正，然后将技能和规范都表示为确定性有限自动机。这把约束转化为可执行的有限状态对象：一个学习到的技能可以与学习到的夜间睡觉或保持在此生物群落规范相交，从而生成一个控制器，该控制器通过构造而非重复提示来强制执行学习到的约束。在Minecraft中，与程序生成基线可用的相同模拟器/API观察结果相比，CEDAR保持了基线未能保持的时间和空间约束，并摊销了学习技能的重复使用，减少了累积的大型语言模型查询。这些结果表明，正则语言为自然语言指令和具身智能体策略之间提供了一层实用的验证层。
